描述_EN: fuseproject has worked with herman miller, puma, swarovski, danese, bmw mini and coca cola. the fuseproject agency was founded by yves béhar in san francisco in 1999. the xo laptop is designed to operate as part of a communal open network allowing the distribution of knowledge and learning through open-source applications and software. the xo laptop is designed as part of the one laptop per child (olpc) initiative, a non-profit organisation created by mit professor nicholas negroponte in 2002. the xo was designed to withstand varying weather and environmental conditions, with no hard drive and only two internal cables as research by fuseproject, the design partner appointed by olpc, found that these were the two elements most likely to fail. béhar was born in switzerland and was educated in europe and in the us. the laptops have wi-fi antenna that are three times as powerful as a standard laptop and can create a mesh network where if one laptop is connected to a network, all others nearby can connect to this first laptop and share this network too. the laptops can run on both linux and windows xp operating systems. the following year he was appointed chair of the industrial design programme at the california college of the arts, a position he currently holds. the screen pivots around so that the laptop can be used as an ebook reader, while the keyboard is a single rubberised sheet to prevent dust and water entering, with smaller keys than a normal keyboard, again designed for children. his work was featured in monographic exhibitions at the san francisco museum of modern art and the museé de design et d’arts appliqués contemporains in lausanne in 2004. the casing has two green 'ears' that act as wi-fi antennae, appealing to children, and a rechargeable battery provides up to 22.8 watt-hours.
描述_ZN: fuseproject曾与赫尔曼-米勒、彪马、施华洛世奇、丹尼斯、宝马迷你和可口可乐合作。 Fuseproject机构由Yves Béhar于1999年在旧金山创立。 XO笔记本电脑被设计成作为公共开放网络的一部分，允许通过开源的应用程序和软件分发知识和学习。 XO笔记本是作为每个孩子一台笔记本（OLPC）倡议的一部分而设计的，这是一个由麻省理工学院教授尼古拉斯-尼葛洛庞帝在2002年创建的非营利组织。 XO的设计能够承受不同的天气和环境条件，没有硬盘，只有两条内部电缆，因为Olpc指定的设计合作伙伴fuseproject的研究发现，这两个元素最容易发生故障。 贝哈尔出生在瑞士，在欧洲和美国接受教育。 笔记本电脑的Wi-Fi天线是标准笔记本电脑的三倍，并且可以创建一个网状网络，如果一台笔记本电脑连接到一个网络，附近所有其他的笔记本电脑也可以连接到这第一台笔记本电脑并分享这个网络。 笔记本电脑可以在Linux和Windows XP操作系统上运行。 次年，他被任命为加州艺术学院工业设计课程的主席，他目前担任这一职务。 屏幕可以旋转，这样笔记本就可以作为电子书阅读器使用，而键盘是一块橡胶板，防止灰尘和水进入，按键比普通键盘小，也是为儿童设计的。 他的作品在2004年在旧金山现代艺术博物馆和洛桑设计与应用艺术博物馆的专题展览中展出。 外壳有两个绿色的 "耳朵"，作为Wi-Fi天线，对儿童很有吸引力，可充电电池提供22.8瓦时。
